load_model_with_DetectionTSCheckpointer: load a model checkpoint into the student model using DetectionTSCheckpointer for teacher-student detection training
load_student_model_only: load only the student model weights from a Caffe2 checkpoint using _load_student_model method
align_Caffe2_state_dicts: align and update Caffe2 model state dicts using name-matching heuristics via align_and_update_state_dicts
handle_incompatible_keys: handle missing, unexpected, and incorrect shape keys when loading a checkpoint into the student model
strip_module_prefix: strip the module prefix from checkpoint state dicts loaded from DataParallel or DistributedDataParallel wrapped models
